title: Why play Bc4? | The Italian Game

heading: Why play
Bc4?
scenes.body: A bishop move with a bigger idea.
scenes.voice: Why play bishop to C four? Let's find out.

heading: Meet the
Italian Game.
scenes.body: Bring your bishop into the game.
scenes.note: An active square. A clear plan.
scenes.voice: Develop a piece, with a plan.

heading: Aim at
f7.
scenes.body: Only Black's king defends this pawn.
scenes.voice: First, aim at F seven. Right now, only Black's king defends that pawn.

heading: Make room
to castle.
scenes.body: Bc4 clears f1. Nf3 already cleared g1.
scenes.note: The path to kingside castling is clear.
scenes.voice: Next, clear the way to castle. Your king now has room.

heading: Prepare
c3, then d4.
scenes.body: c3 supports a future d4 advance.
scenes.note: Your pieces and pawns work together.
scenes.voice: Then, support D four with C three. You're preparing to challenge the center.

heading: Find the
bishop move.
scenes.body: Which square brings these ideas together?
scenes.note: Take a moment. Choose your square.
scenes.voice: Your turn. Where should the bishop go?

heading: Learn it.
Then remember it.
scenes.body: Practice the Italian Game in the app.
scenes.voice: Practice the full Italian Game in the app. Then play it from memory.
